programme.title: La minute de Mike!
programme.desc: C'est bizarre, on fait toujours le même rêve ; un chien qui essaie de séduire sa voisine et qui se bat contre des ratons ; on se demande ce que cela peut bien signifier.

programme.title: T'es où Chicky?
programme.desc: Chicky et Bekky font les funambules, lorsqu'un énorme engin leur fonce dessus!

programme.title: Wowanimo

programme.desc: When a mating pair of abnormals is brought in for scientific study, the team begins to exhibit attractions for each other.

programme.title: Selena
programme.desc: A beautiful Mexican-American singer's (Jennifer Lopez) skyrocketing international career ends abruptly.

programme.title: Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves
programme.desc: The archer and his Moorish companion join Sherwood Forest outlaws to fight against the sheriff of Nottingham, who desires to possess Maid Marian.

programme.title: Girl, Interrupted
programme.desc: A young woman (Winona Ryder) with a borderline personality disorder stays in a 1960s mental institution for 18 months.

programme.title: The Perks of Being a Wallflower
programme.desc: Socially awkward Charlie is a wallflower watching from the sidelines, until a pair of charismatic seniors take him under their wing.

programme.title: Mary & George
programme.desc: With Somerset keeping George on the back foot, Mary must find a way to make allies fast and overcome the Somersets or risk losing everything; Francis Bacon senses an opportunity to influence George.

programme.title: Mary & George
programme.desc: George faces a daunting trip to Scotland with an erratic and closed off King James; Mary attempts to enforce the marriage of John and Frances, but a fired-up Lady Hatton stands in her way.

programme.title: Slumber Party Massacre
programme.desc: A slumber party turns into a bloodbath, as a psychotic serial killer wielding a power drill disrupts the fun.

programme.title: Edge of the Knife
programme.desc: A tragic accident causes an anguished man to retreat deep into the forest where he is transformed into a "wild man."

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Dr. Magnus travels to Rome to lead a covert meeting on abnormals; the Cabal seeks revenge for the release of the three witches from Scotland.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: A young artist with the ability to draw detailed pictures from memory may be the key to solving a case surrounding the suspicious death of his abusive father.

programme.title: Goose!
programme.desc: A boy (Max Morrow) conspires to save a talking gander from a man (Chevy Chase) who plans to cook the bird in an upcoming culinary contest.

programme.title: Looney Tunes: Back in Action
programme.desc: Bugs Bunny tries to find Daffy Duck after the Daffy loses his job and travels to Las Vegas with a man.

programme.title: Ozzy
programme.desc: A lovable dog must rely on some new friends to help it break out of canine prison and get back home to his owners.

programme.title: The Outsiders

programme.title: Dirty Dancing

programme.title: Steel Magnolias

programme.title: 9 to 5

programme.title: The Heat

programme.title: Tammy
programme.desc: After losing her job, wrecking her car and discovering her husband's infidelity, a woman (Melissa McCarthy) hits the road with her feisty grandmother (Susan Sarandon).

programme.title: Mary & George
programme.desc: A political crisis triggered by the return of the legendary and infamous Sir Walter Raleigh drives a wedge between Mary, George and King James.

programme.title: Mary & George
programme.desc: Anti-Spanish riots have taken hold of the city, and with the Crown plunged into debt, George stands to lose everything; Mary faces devastating consequences when she overplays her hand.

programme.title: Blood Quantum
programme.desc: The dead are coming back to life and almost all of Earth's population is decimated due to a zombie virus, except for the isolated Mi'kmaq reserve of Red Crow, whose indigenous inhabitants are strangely immune to the zombie plague.

programme.title: Before My Heart Falls
programme.desc: A teenager has a key moment in her life before she commits an act she will always regret.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: Dr. Magnus and Will investigate a distressing call for help deep below the Bermuda Triangle resulting in a deadly battle to save Magnus's life.

programme.title: Sanctuary
programme.desc: While investigating the disappearance of an old college friend, Will finds himself caught in an underground fight club.

programme.title: Air Bud

programme.title: Superman III

programme.title: Upside Down

programme.title: The Intern

programme.title: Mary & George
